storyboard.ears: One country now has way more robot coworkers than you have fingers.
South Korea has 1,220 robots for every ten thousand factory workers, the most anywhere. Germany and Japan, famous for factories, trail far behind.
storyboard.evidence: International Federation of Robotics (IFR), via Supply Chain 247 | Industrial robots per 10,000 manufacturing workers, top countries | https://www.supplychain247.com/article/robot-density-rises-global-manufacturing-ifr-report/automation | 2026-11-12

storyboard.ears: The United States has 307 robots per ten thousand workers. South Korea has nearly four times that, a huge gap.
storyboard.evidence: International Federation of Robotics (IFR), via Supply Chain 247 | Robot density: South Korea vs the United States | https://www.supplychain247.com/article/robot-density-rises-global-manufacturing-ifr-report/automation | 2026-11-12

storyboard.ears: China installs more robots than anyone, yet ranks only 22nd in density, since its workforce is so huge.
storyboard.evidence: International Federation of Robotics (IFR), via Supply Chain 247 | Most robots installed vs highest robot density | https://www.supplychain247.com/article/robot-density-rises-global-manufacturing-ifr-report/automation | 2026-11-12

storyboard.ears: Robots per worker, not total robots, shows who is really automating, and South Korea is miles ahead.
